newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-SONICS COACH KARL FINED $7,500.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-SONICS COACH KARL FINED $7,500.

text.p: Seattle SuperSonics coach George Karl was fined $7,500 by the NBA on Monday for his actions in last Thursday's game against Minnesota.
Karl was fined for verbally abusing the referees and refusing to leave the court in a timely fashion following his ejection with five minutes left in the fourth quarter of Seattle's 117-86 win.
The ejection carried an additional $1,000 fine.
